question.text: Cerium  <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Z</mi><mo>=</mo><mtext>58</mtext></mrow></mfenced></math>  is a member of the lanthanoids. Identify the incorrect statements about cerium from the following

options.text: The +4 oxidation state of cerium is not known in solutions
The +3 oxidation state of cerium is more stable than the +4 oxidation state
The common oxidation states of cerium are +3 and +4
Cerium (IV) acts as an oxidizing agent

solution.text:
The common oxidation states of cerium are +3 and +4. In which +3 state is more stable.

+ 4 oxidation state of cerium is also known in solution.
